liturgicalName: Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
gospelRef: Luke 1:39-56 (Mass during the Day; Vigil: Luke 11:27-28)
keyVerseDR: "...behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed." (Lk 1:48)

level1.title: Mary Goes to Heaven
level1.story: Mary visited her cousin Elizabeth. Elizabeth said, "Blessed are you among women!" Mary sang a song praising God. Today we celebrate that God took Mary, body and soul, into heaven.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Holy Mary, pray for us. Amen.

activity.title: Rosary for Mary
activity.intro: Color 10 beads and pray a Hail Mary for each.
activity.label: Mary, pray for us!

level2.title: The Magnificat
level2.story: Mary went with haste to the hill country to visit her cousin Elizabeth. When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and she said, "Blessed art thou among women." Mary said, "My soul doth magnify the Lord. And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour." She said, "For behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed." Today we celebrate that Mary was taken up body and soul into heaven.
level2.keyLine: All generations shall call me blessed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does the Assumption promise us?
Which line of the Magnificat do you like best?
level2.prayer: Mary, assumed into heaven, pray for us. Amen.
